verdict.rationale: DPMA is an IP office offering online services (DEPATISnet, DPMAregister, DPMAdirektWeb). A service of this kind could plausibly ship an official CLI, so the axis applies. The only downloadable tool in evidence is the DPMAdirektPro application software for creating and validating filings, which is desktop filing software, not a CLI. No evidence of any official command-line tool exists in the pack.
